items.quote: Our FY27 credit cost guidance of 4% to 4.5% reflects a new PAR 15 accretion rate of 30-35 bps per month.
items.speaker: Ganesh Narayanan

items.quote: moving closer to the medium-term target of 25-30% by FY28 as we scale our business
items.statement: Foreign borrowings share of 25-30% of total borrowings by FY28
items.speaker: Ganesh Narayanan

items.quote: So maybe for next year, we should see the NIMs anywhere between maybe 14% to 14.5%
items.statement: NIM of 14% to 14.5% for FY27 for some time
items.speaker: Nilesh Dalvi

items.quote: we will try to maintain our ROAs in 4.0-4.5% range
items.speaker: Nilesh Dalvi

items.quote: we would want to do a cross-cycle ROA of 4% and ROE of around 16%-17% on a cross cycle
items.statement: Cross-cycle ROE of around 16-17% (with ROA of about 4%)
items.speaker: Nilesh Dalvi

items.quote: we need to do at least a 20% growth every year to reach our medium-term goal
items.statement: At least 20% growth every year to reach medium-term goal
items.speaker: Ganesh Narayanan

items.quote: I think new customer acquisition will pick up traction in Q4 itself.
items.statement: New customer acquisition to pick up in Q4FY26
items.speaker: Rajiv Mehta

tone.label: cautious
tone.why: Management says asset quality is normalising, but repeatedly defers firm FY27 growth and credit cost guidance until it sees the trend hold into May.
